answer: To join, each agent must forge a stake-backed identity: lock 500 POA for 30 epochs, slashable if peers prove two identities share one operator. A farm riding the tide of 1,000 fake aliases must lock 500,000 POA up front, and a single echo — one reused fingerprint, key, or funding trail — burns the whole stake. Honest agents pay once and earn it back; sybils pay per alias and lose everything.
